/*updateMasterCmClSalesTaxExportSum_ICOMGRDT*/
UPDATE ICOMGRDT GR /* 구매사별 입고정보 */ SET AR_TAX_BILL_NO = #{order_no} , AR_CLOSE_DEPT = LPAD(#{dept_code},3,0) , AR_CLOSE_MONTH = #{issue_date} , AR_CLOSE_REVISION = #{st_close_revision} , AR_BILL_FLAG = 'Y' , CLOSE_USER_ID = DECODE(CLOSE_USER_ID,NULL,#{st_user_id},CLOSE_USER_ID) WHERE 1=1 AND GR_DATE BETWEEN #{key_gr_from_date} AND #{key_gr_to_date} AND BUYER = #{buyer_code} AND AR_BILL_FLAG = 'N' AND STATUS <> 'D' AND (GR.BUYER, GR.GR_NO, GR.GR_SEQ) IN ( SELECT GR.BUYER, GR.GR_NO, GR.GR_SEQ FROM ICOMGRDT GR , ICOMPOHD POHD , ICOMPODT PODT , ICOMPRDT PRDT , ICOMCMPY CMPY , ICOMBYIT BYIT WHERE 1=1 AND GR.BUYER = CMPY.COM_CODE AND GR.BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND GR.PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO AND GR.PO_SEQ = PODT.PO_SEQ AND POHD.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ AND CMPY.BYCA_COMORG_CODE = BYIT.BUYER AND BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = PRDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = GR.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND GR.AR_BILL_FLAG = 'N' AND GR.STATUS <> 'D' AND POHD.DOC_TYPE <> 'X' AND GR.BUYER =#{buyer_code} AND GR.GR_DATE BETWEEN #{key_gr_from_date} AND #{key_gr_to_date} AND GR.EXP_GR_NO =#{key_exp_gr_no} AND GR.EXP_DATE_OF_SHIPMENT = #{key_exp_date} AND GR.EXP_CUR = #{key_exp_cur} AND GR.EXP_CUR_PRICE = #{key_exp_cur_price} )

, TOT_SUPP_PRICE , TOT_TAX_PRICE , TOT_AMT , SUPP_PRICE , TAX_PRICE , AMT
, TAX_TYPE , BILL_TYPE , PRINT_DATE , PRINT_USER_ID , PRINT_CNT , PRINT_AVAIL_CNT , CONFIRM_FLAG , REMARK_DESCRIPTION , REMARK_SPECIFICATION , REMARK_QTY , REMARK_PRICE
, ASK_TYPE , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID
, AR_CLOSE_MONTH , AR_CLOSE_REVISION , KEP_IRS_NAME , KEP_CEO_NAME_LOC , KEP_INDUSTRY_TYPE , KEP_BUSINESS_ITEMS , KEP_ADDRESS_LOC , IRS_NAME , CEO_NAME_LOC , INDUSTRY_TYPE , BUSINESS_ITEMS , ADDRESS_LOC , GR_CREATOR_NAME , GR_CREATOR_EMAIL , EXP_CUR , EXP_CUR_PRICE , EXP_FOR_ITEM_AMT , EXP_GR_NO , EXP_DATE_OF_SHIPMENT ) SELECT TAX_BILL_NO , KEP_IRS , SITE , (SELECT MAX(CODE2) FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'ITGR' AND BUYER = #{buyer_code} AND FLAG = 'Y') , STATUS , ISSUE_DATE , CUSTOMER_NAME , IRS_NO , BUYER_CODE
, TOT_SUPP_PRICE , TOT_TAX_PRICE , TOT_AMT , TRUNC(#{it_amt}) , DECODE(TAX_TYPE, '11', TRUNC(#{it_amt} * 0.1) ,0) , DECODE(TAX_TYPE, '11', TRUNC(#{it_amt}) + TRUNC(#{it_amt} * 0.1) , TRUNC(#{it_amt}))
, TAX_TYPE , BILL_TYPE , PRINT_DATE , PRINT_USER_ID , PRINT_CNT , PRINT_AVAIL_CNT , CONFIRM_FLAG , REMARK_DESCRIPTION , REMARK_SPECIFICATION , REMARK_QTY , TRUNC(#{it_amt})
, ASK_TYPE , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID
, AR_CLOSE_MONTH , AR_CLOSE_REVISION , KEP_IRS_NAME , KEP_CEO_NAME_LOC , KEP_INDUSTRY_TYPE , KEP_BUSINESS_ITEMS , KEP_ADDRESS_LOC , IRS_NAME , CEO_NAME_LOC , INDUSTRY_TYPE , BUSINESS_ITEMS , ADDRESS_LOC , GR_CREATOR_NAME , GR_CREATOR_EMAIL , EXP_CUR , EXP_CUR_PRICE , EXP_FOR_ITEM_AMT , EXP_GR_NO , EXP_DATE_OF_SHIPMENT FROM KEPTARDT WHERE TAX_BILL_NO = #{ar_no}

/* updateMasterCmClSalesTaxExportSum_IT_ICOMGRDT */
UPDATE ICOMGRDT SET AR_CLOSE_DEPT = (SELECT MAX(CODE2) FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'ITGR' AND BUYER = #{buyer_code} AND FLAG = 'Y') WHERE (BUYER, GR_NO, GR_SEQ) IN ( SELECT DISTINCT GR.BUYER, GR.GR_NO, GR.GR_SEQ FROM ICOMGRDT GR , ICOMPODT PD WHERE 1=1 AND GR.BUYER = PD.BUYER AND GR.PO_NO = PD.PO_NO AND GR.PO_SEQ = PD.PO_SEQ AND GR.STATUS <> 'D' AND PD.STATUS <> 'D' AND GR.BUYER = #{buyer_code} AND GR.AR_TAX_BILL_NO = #{ar_no} AND GR.AR_BILL_FLAG = 'Y' AND PD.CMS_CATEG_ID IN (SELECT CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'ITGR' AND BUYER = #{buyer_code} AND FLAG = 'Y') )

/*insertMasterCmClSalesTaxExportSum_BillCloseList*/
MERGE INTO BILL_CLOSE_USER_LIST A USING ( SELECT (SELECT LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{st_user_id}) AS LEGACY_USER_ID, #{issue_date} AS BILL_CLOSE_MONTH, 'AR' AS CLOSE_TYPE, #{buyer_code} AS BUYER_CODE FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND A.LEGACY_USER_ID = B.LEGACY_USER_ID AND A.BILL_CLOSE_MONTH = B.BILL_CLOSE_MONTH AND A.CLOSE_TYPE = B.CLOSE_TYPE AND A.BUYER_CODE = B.BUYER_CODE ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( LEGACY_USER_ID, BILL_CLOSE_MONTH, CLOSE_TYPE, SEQ, KEP_DEPT, BUYER_CODE, AGENT_CODE, CLOSE_CMPL_YN ) VALUES ( (SELECT LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{st_user_id}), #{issue_date}, 'AR', (SELECT NVL(MAX(SEQ),0) +1 FROM BILL_CLOSE_USER_LIST WHERE LEGACY_USER_ID = (SELECT LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{st_user_id}) AND BILL_CLOSE_MONTH = #{issue_date} AND CLOSE_TYPE = 'AR' ), #{dept_code}, #{buyer_code}, '', 'N' )
